name: Pinoy Big Brother
description: The Philippine adaptation of the reality game show "Big Brother" features Filipino housemates live together, share their stories and build meaningful relationships as they do tasks and challenges supervised by Big Brother. Every week a nomination is done, and the public decides who gets evicted and eventually become the Big Winner of the program.

videos.title: PBB 10 Big Kumunity Party
videos.overview: “Pinoy Big Brother” officially welcomes its 12 celebrity housemates as it kicks off its 10th season. While the housemates receive their first task, five more personalities are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Gen Z revolution era officially starts as the latest batch of housemates enters the iconic PBB house. To make it more legendary, Big Brother immediately gives a difficult challenge.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dingdong and Patrick make a difficult decision, as only one of them is given the chance to enter the house. Just as they make themselves comfortable in the PBB House, the new housemates get shocked by Big Brother’s announcement.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: On their first official day inside the PBB house, each housemates receive a special gift from their loved ones. Emotions overflow as they share the stories behind their cherished presents.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Big Brother tests the housemates' growing friendship by letting them decide who among the remaining house guests deserves to stay in the PBB house. Soon, four more housemates become official.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As they finally reunite inside the PBB house, Patrick and Dingdong do their best to hide their true relationship from the housemates. The newcomer's arrival alarms the remaining house guests.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The housemates and house guests receive their first weekly task. Patrick and Dingdong continue putting on an act as the group tries to get to know their newest member. Soon, devastating news about the outside world reaches them.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Big Brother tasks his first seven official housemates to decide on the fate of the remaining house guests. Soon, tears and shattered dreams fill the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Emotions run high as the housemates and the house guests continue to decide their fate inside the PBB house. Soon, Big Brother makes an important announcement amid their first weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After deciding between Brx, Denn, Kolette, and Dylan for automatic nomination, the housemates are stunned by an unexpected revelation. Shortly after, two other housemates receive bad news on the season’s first nomination night.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The nominated housemates reflect on their behavior from the past week. The next day, the PBB house gets transformed into a toddler's playroom. Kolette opens up about her relationships with her adoptive and biological parents.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Big Brother gives his housemates a task to cheer up the unsuspecting Kolette. Soon, an emotional reunion transpires between the Ma-cute-lit Raketera of General Santos and her biological mother.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ten naughty big babies bring good vibes, laughter, and a bit of chaos into the PBB house. Kanata shares with Big Brother her heartfelt wish to meet her biological father.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Big Brother makes a promise after learning about Kanata’s deep longing for her father. Shortly after, the housemates find out that they need to accomplish the big babies’ requests in order to win their weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Tension rises as one of the big babies throws a temper tantrum. After managing to fulfill Baby Therese's request, Noimie receives her special birthday gift from Big Brother.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Seeing how fast Brx and Noimie accomplish their big baby's request, Jas feels frustrated when she struggles to fulfill her tasks. A new process is unveiled as the first housemate gets evicted.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The housemates attempt to fulfill the remaining baby requests to boost their chances of winning the weekly task. Following the second nomination night, two new housemates join Kuya's house.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Newest housemates Sofia "Fyang" Smith and Jan Emmanuel Silva enter the house wearing funny filter masks. To welcome the newcomers and help them remove their masks, the other housemates participate in a humorous task.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After familiarizing themselves with the newcomers, the housemates waste no time preparing for their latest task. Being a content creator herself, Fyang opens up to Big Brother about her struggles.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The housemates put forth their best efforts to create a music video for their second weekly task. Amid this, the growing closeness between Marc and Fyang becomes a hot topic among the other housemates.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The housemates are filled with joy after receiving positive feedback on their weekly task. However, Marc lands in hot water as both the housemates and netizens begin talking about his supposed attempts to get close to Fyang.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: With limited time on their hands, the housemates step up their game to complete the final music video for their weekly task. Task leader Dingdong shares how being a content creator helps him overcome his personal struggles.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The housemates put a smile on everyone's faces as they perform a snippet of Binsoy's original composition. However, the Big Brother house is soon filled with gloom when two nominees bid farewell.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: After receiving the result of their third weekly task, Dingdong and Patrick resolve to voice out their concerns regarding food sharing. Four housemates face the threat of eviction following the third nomination night.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After being nominated, the five adult housemates sit down to resolve their misunderstandings. One of the nominated housemates opens up about their sexuality. Later, Big Brother welcomes two new housemates.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Joli breaks into a sweat as she tries to accomplish her secret task with JP, unaware that the housemates are starting to sense something suspicious about her.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Pressure creeps up on Joli and JP as Big Brother raises the stakes for their secret task. Meanwhile, several housemates voice out their concerns about Fyang's behavior.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: JM cautions Fyang to be mindful of her conduct, concerned that their companions might misinterpret her actions. Big Brother devises a plan to help the housemates get to know each other on a deeper level.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The housemates bust their guts to make Jan's birthday extra special. Misunderstandings arise between Fyang and JM after a thoughtless joke takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: As they continue to struggle to keep their raft afloat, the housemates participate in a compatibility test to gain more materials for their ship. Two nominees end their journey inside the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Big Brother accepts Fyang’s request for JM’s birthday on one condition. After receiving a shocking announcement regarding their weekly task, the housemates try their best to succeed in the Relay Ang Ship task.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: After waking up his tenants with a chilling alarm, Big Brother uses the rule book to punish the housemates for committing several violations within his house.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Binsoy gets emotional after Big Brother announces that he is one of the automatic nominees, unaware that the inclusion of the housemates who took responsibility for their violations on the list is not yet final.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Big Brother gives Binsoy, Jarren, and JP a secret mission. Through a fun guessing game, Joli reunites with a special person in her heart as the latter enters the PBB house as the newest housemate.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Big Brother informs Gwen and Joli that they are the second two-in-one housemates in his house. Fyang raises the issue of backstabbing during an open discussion. Rain and Jarren receive a mind-boggling task.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Jarren and Rain seek a little help from Jas and Jan in figuring out a puzzling message concerning Kai. Soon, Kai's mother delivers some hopeful news to her precious daughter.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Pressure runs high as the housemates' basic ball skills and teamwork are put to the test in their Team to Beat task. Soon, the latest evictee is named.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: After boosting their spirits with the cheers they prepared, the housemates take on their Team to Beat task. Three housemates receive bad news during the fifth nomination night.
